title: Aggregation of Published Non-Uniform Axial Power Data for Phase II of the OECD/NEA AI/ML Critical Heat Flux Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2507.00034v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Critical heat flux (CHF) marks the onset of boiling crisis in light-water reactors, defining safe thermal-hydraulic operating limits. To support Phase II of the OECD/NEA AI/ML CHF benchmark, which introduces spatially varying power profiles, this work compiles and digitizes a broad CHF dataset covering both uniform and non-uniform axial heating conditions. Heating profiles were extracted from technical reports, interpolated onto a consistent axial mesh, validated via energy-balance checks, and encoded in machine-readable formats for benchmark compatibility. Classical CHF correlations exhibit substantial errors under uniform heating and degrade markedly when applied to non-uniform profiles, while modern tabular methods offer improved but still imperfect predictions. translated_title: 面向OECD/NEA人工智能/机器学习临界热流密度基准第二阶段的已发表非均匀轴向功率数据汇集
translated_abstract: 临界热流密度（CHF）标志着轻水反应堆中沸腾危机的发生，界定了安全的热工水力运行极限。为支持OECD/NEA AI/ML CHF基准第二阶段（该阶段引入了空间变化的功率分布），本工作汇集并数字化了一个涵盖均匀与非均匀轴向加热条件的大规模CHF数据集。加热分布从技术报告中提取，插值到统一的轴向网格上，通过能量平衡检查进行验证，并以机器可读格式编码以保证与基准的兼容性。经典CHF关联式在均匀加热条件下已存在较大误差，在应用于非均匀分布时性能明显下降；现代表格方法虽有所改进，但预测仍不完美。仅用均匀数据训练的神经网络在该工况下表现良好，但无法泛化到空间变化的场景，凸显了对能够……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本工作为OECD/NEA AI/ML临界热流密度基准第二阶段汇集并数字化了涵盖均匀与非均匀轴向加热条件的大规模CHF数据集，并揭示经典关联式和仅用均匀数据训练的神经网络在非均匀功率分布下均难以准确预测，凸显了开发泛化能力更强的AI/ML模型的必要性。
en_tdlr: This work compiles and digitizes a broad CHF dataset covering both uniform and non-uniform axial heating conditions for Phase II of the OECD/NEA AI/ML CHF benchmark, demonstrating that classical correlations and neural networks trained only on uniform data fail to generalize to spatially varying power profiles.
